RECUR / 环生

Play music as structure.

Click DEMO or import a local recording. This earlier browser study explores folding and layered structures driven by audio.

A S D J K L / 4—7
Ten manual forms. Select a form to take over; click AUTO to follow music again.
SPACE / XY FX
Hold Space, then release. Drag FX to change torsion and echo.
LOOP / REC / 16
Overdub six voices into a 16-step grid. Drag the decks to change speed; use the crossfader to mix.
P / M / H / F
Pause / mute / hide interface / fullscreen. U imports, T plays the demo, Z/X change octave.
SAVE / LOAD
Save an image and local session. Imported audio stays in the browser.
